capabilities: Capture notes from a bottom composer without naming files or choosing folders
Nest notes by drilling in, and promote, demote, move, merge and clone them into outlines
Turn notes into tasks with due dates, reminders, assignees and a today-focused view with a pomodoro timer
Search Stashpad folders with all-words, any-order matching and filters
Export notes as checklists, indented outlines, embed links, or Open Knowledge Format bundles
disambiguation: Not the standalone Stashpad Notes app; it is an Obsidian plugin inspired by that shut-down app.
extras: Alpha software; the maintainer directs it but an AI assistant writes the code and nobody reviews it line by line. Encryption is an unaudited beta that can lose data, and the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later.
motivation: Built as a homage to Stashpad Notes, an app that shut down in 2024, bringing its chat-style, jot-it-down feel into Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's normal flow requires inventing a filename and picking a folder before writing anything, which adds friction to jotting down a quick thought.

relations.evidence: Stashpad is a homage to Stashpad Notes, a lovely app that shut down in 2024.
That conversion is adapted from the Excel to Markdown Table plugin by Ganessh Kumar R P (MIT)
The handling of quoted and multi-line cells comes from our sibling plugin GridSense.

summary: Chat-style capture workspace that stacks notes newest-first, nests them into outlines, and adds tasks, reminders, search, and OKF export.
